run_config_parser_with_args: run config_parser with a list of command line arguments to parse RoDynRF training options
run_config_parser_from_cli: run config_parser with no arguments to parse RoDynRF options from the system command line
build_training_config: build a RoDynRF training configuration by passing model name, dataset, and learning rate arguments to config_parser
build_rendering_config: build a RoDynRF rendering configuration by passing render_only, render_test, and ray_type arguments to config_parser
review_config_parser_arguments: review the config_parser function to understand all 80 plus arguments for RoDynRF dynamic NeRF training and rendering
